title: 古拉加斯·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 姜红大胡须十分醒目，秃顶两侧的红发衬着宽阔鼻形。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Gragas is a very large broad adult man with a thick ginger beard, a bald crown with red hair at the sides, a broad nose, and a heavy powerful build. Preserve his immense barrel-like silhouette and huge wooden cask while clothing him in a fully covering substantial shirt, dark vest, opaque trousers, and boots, without exposed belly or drunken expression.
art_direction.scene: A low three-quarter full-figure study, grounded relaxed stance, clear triangular silhouette and one bright diagonal of sunlight. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: ginger red, pine, wood brown, pale gold light; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
